cells.gaps: Commencement is not stated, so the law is not shown in force. ESCWA's profile of December 2025 says no comprehensive law is in place (COM-005), against the 2021 enactment (COM-001). No regulations or application have been found. The authority is named in the law (Article 19) and, per a 2024 source, not yet constituted.
cells.note: The law was enacted on 29 June 2021, and the strongest standing stated is the country's, so ESCWA's statement of December 2025 does not lower it: stage 3. Stage 4 needs the law in force and a dated decision under it, and neither is held.
